free_tier.stated: Quoted from the pricing FAQ: 'Is there a free trial? No. SaladCloud and the Transcription API are pay-as-you-go with no minimum commitment, so you can start with a small, low-cost test before scaling.' Rate quoted: GPUs from USD 0.015 per hour, billed per second.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: None without a first payment. USD 0.015/h is the cheapest per-hour GPU figure found in this class, so it is the right target once any budget exists.

limits.value: There is no free lane at all, so the binding constraint is the first dollar: a user must fund a prepaid balance before any container runs.

independent check dated 2026-09-18 reaches the same conclusion against the official pricing and get-started pages, and notes the withdrawn 5-audio-hour transcription trial
the only free credit Salad advertises is USD 5k-10k for 'qualifying companies' through its Solutions Architect Program, a sales-gated door not available to an individual

notes: Salad's USD 0.015/h is the lowest headline GPU rate in the whole class and it is a genuine consumer-GPU network, but the free door is closed. The SSAP grant (USD 5k-10k) is recorded here as a fails-identity door inside a paid-only record: it needs a company, not a person.
